title: Moving a ticket in a blueprint to another department keeps its blueprint status (On Hold); Zoho resets it to Open

Allowed. The ticket leaves the blueprint (no blueprint strip, Status unlocked) and the owner becomes Unassigned. Zoho help: moved tickets are treated as new tickets in the receiving department and their status is set to Open.
Allowed (200). The ticket leaves the blueprint (no Steps card) and the owner becomes Unassigned — same as Zoho.
Reset to "Open" in the new department.
Stays "On Hold" — the status the blueprint set in the old department is carried into the new department, where no blueprint or rule put it there.
